capture.//: Writes the landing-page scenes to dist/site-shots from a production build and a seeded disposable homeserver.

options.command: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/site-shots', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node e2e/support/run-playwright.mts --config=e2e/site-shots/playwright.config.mts --build=trinity:build:production --resource=homeserver

capture-prebuilt.//: Writes the landing-page scenes to dist/site-shots from the production build already in www/ and a seeded disposable homeserver.

options.command: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/site-shots', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node e2e/support/run-playwright.mts --config=e2e/site-shots/playwright.config.mts --resource=homeserver
